name: Device frame
description: A phone or browser frame with a transparent screen. The footage is a separate clip on the track under it, its box on the frame's screen (component.screens gives the screen rect per device, in the size's pixels). timeline_edit's insert_device_frame inserts both, aligned.
author: Biliup

device.description: phone: rounded phone with a camera pill; android: punch-hole phone; browser: a browser window.

color.description: The frame's colour (a theme token or CSS colour). Default near-black.

url.description: browser only: the address shown in the bar.
